description: Patch releases are deliberately not automerged here, unlike in most other roles in this fleet.

Outline applies its database migrations automatically at container start, forward-only, and its patch releases do ship them: 1.8.0 -> 1.8.1 added increase-url-column-lengths, and 1.9.1 -> 1.9.2 added add-mcp-to-search-queries-source.
An automerged patch would therefore rewrite the schema of the database holding the users' documents, unattended and with no way back short of restoring a backup.
